undated_mentions: Originally attached to the Ministry of Heavy Industries.
Library was first in the new states to join Deutsches Wissenschaftsnetz (after German reunification).
Late 1960s: university reforms restructured institutes into sections (Chemistry, Process Chemistry, Process Engineering, Polymer Sciences, SBW, KMD).
Faculty structure reintroduced after German reunification.
